overrides.purpose: Minimal configuration-only successor to the failed V23 Pilot. V24 preserves the frozen baseline, complete state/card/legal-action context, CoT route behavior, memory content, retrieval, injection and reflection semantics byte-for-byte. It removes the obsolete 16000-character memory-only action-prompt ceiling that terminated V23 after 92 real injections, while retaining an explicit fail-closed capacity equal to the already established lossless provider envelope. V23 remains an immutable failed historical artifact.

memory.action_memory_capacity_contract: Every selected Pending and Active experience is appended exactly once without Top-K, truncation, summarization, or semantic Python filtering. Rendering fails closed only when the complete memory payload exceeds the same 3000000-character provider envelope used by lossless reflection requests.
